en.quote: Who can stand before his indignation? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger? his fury is poured out like fire, and the rocks are thrown down by him.
en.riddle: Who can stand before his indignation? and who can abide in the fierceness of his anger?
en.speaker: Narrator

he.quote: לִפְנֵי זַעְמוֹ מִי יַֽעֲמוֹד וּמִי יָקוּם בַּחֲרוֹן אַפּוֹ חֲמָתוֹ נִתְּכָה כָאֵשׁ וְהַצֻּרִים נִתְּצוּ מִמֶּֽנּוּ
